newsitem.title: USA: Western Resources to announce merger - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Western Resources to announce merger - NYT.

text.p: Western Resources is expected to announce within the next few days the acquisition of Kansas City Power and Light for $2 billion in stock, the New York Times said on Friday.
Citing two people familiar with the deal, the paper said Western's board had approved the merger on Tuesday and that Kansas City Power's board is expected to approve it as soon as Friday afternoon.

On Thursday both companies said substantive merger negotiations were continuing. They said Western had extended its takeover offer for K.C. Power and that about 49 percent of K. C. Power's outstanding shares had been tendered to Western.
In June Western raised its offer to $31 per share from $28 per share. The deal is now valued at $32 per share, Friday's paper said.
